declarations.docstring: An auxiliary proposition involving a finite group representation, subgroups, and representation data.
An auxiliary proposition involving a finite group representation, subgroups, and representation data.
Characterizes when the column range of a matrix spans the full module by linear independence of its rows.
Maps complex-valued coefficient vectors indexed by a finite representation index to group functions.
Evaluating the complex coefficient map on a converted integer-matrix column gives the corresponding indexed group function.
Converts every integer entry of a matrix to a complex number.
Expresses the auxiliary complex proposition as spanning by converted integer-matrix columns.
An integer-valued matrix associated with a finite group representation, subgroups, and representation data.
Produces group functions indexed by a family of subgroups and corresponding representations.
The displayed family of complex-valued representation characters is linearly independent.
Maps rational-valued coefficient vectors indexed by a finite representation index to complex-valued group functions.
Evaluating the rational coefficient map on a converted integer-matrix column gives the corresponding indexed group function.
Converts every integer entry of a matrix to a rational number.
Expresses the auxiliary rational proposition as spanning by converted integer-matrix columns.
For an integer matrix, rational column spanning is equivalent to complex column spanning after entrywise conversion.
Associates to each finite representation index a representation of a specified subgroup.
Collects the rational and complex spanning equivalences and their row-linear-independence characterizations for an integer matrix.
Under simplicity of each displayed subgroup representation, relates the auxiliary rational and complex propositions and their matrix row-independence forms.
